implementation.name: Supervision (Analogue Pocket, opengateware)
implementation.notes: Source availability (T5.4): open -- the repository carries 30 HDL source files (11 systemverilog, 11 verilog, 8 vhdl). There is no open_source column in the delivered schema (data-model.md §1.9 deleted the proposed core table together with its flags); the presence of hdl_language_id and of implementation_path rows is how that fact is stated here. Machine mapping: hand-mapped, not setname-derived -- this core ships no MRA file. It reimplements the Watara Supervision, giving machine_id svision, each checked against extract/machine.json. License: https://github.com/opengateware/console-supervision/blob/master/rtl/audio.sv carries the tag SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later -- read from the repository, not inferred; https://github.com/opengateware/console-supervision/blob/master/LICENSE is the matching licence text. hdl_language_id: no single HDL family reaches 90% of the 30 source files (11 systemverilog, 11 verilog, 8 vhdl), excluding the shared framework directory. accuracy_id omitted: the repository makes no timing-fidelity claim this build could verify. Core identity read from the openFPGA manifest pkg/pocket/Cores/boogermann.supervision/core.json in the repository, which declares core identifier boogermann.supervision.
